title: EnchantBook
description: This plugin adds a new mechanic for working with enchanted books: now you can combine two books with different enchantments into one, getting a universal book with multiple enchantments.
body:
**✨ Overview**

This plugin adds a new mechanic for working with enchanted books: now you can combine two books with different enchantments into one, getting a universal book with multiple enchantments. This makes the process of enchanting items more convenient, faster, and more flexible.

---

**⚡ Features**

Combine Enchanted Books – combine two books into one while preserving all the enchantments.
🔀 No enchantment loss – the enchantments from both books are transferred completely.
🎯 Multi-enchant support – the final book can contain 2 or more enchantments.
Easy to use – the resulting book can be used immediately in the anvil.
🎮 Suitable for both PvP servers and survival.

---

**📥 Installation**

Download the .jar plugin.
Move it to the /plugins folder of your server.
Restart the server.
Ready!

---

**🔑 Permissions**

**bookmerger.use** – allows the player to combine books. (default: true for all)
**bookmerger.admin** – access to administrative commands (if needed).

---

**❓ Why download this plugin?**
✔ Save inventory space.
✔ Speeds up the enchantment process.
✔ Simplifies the collection of the "perfect book".
✔ Adds unique functionality that is not found in vanilla Minecraft.
